findings.citation: The geometry of those parts is documented next to the hinge constants in `stack.py`; the depth must follow from the constants, so it stays correct if the screw length or the clearance rule changes.
findings.description: The verifier perturbs screw length and clearance, but never perturbs HINGE_NUT_H or the backing-strip thickness T063. Its differential checks also permit an arbitrary constant excess depth. Thus an implementation can hard-code the strip-and-nut branch (or add an unrelated fixed offset) and pass without deriving the relief depth from all parts that actually enter it, unlike the oracle's exact max(screw tips, strip-and-nuts) plus clearance formula.
